title: Growing lettuce in space
text: Astronauts grew lettuce on the Space Station. Scientists checked whether it was safe and healthy to eat.

title: Plants with roots in the air
text: On the Space Station, scientists tested growing plants without soil, using only water and mist on the roots.

title: Why radiation is dangerous
text: Scientists on Earth studied how space radiation affects the brain cells of mice, to understand the risk to astronauts.

title: Space radiation and the body
text: Using special particle beams on Earth, scientists studied how space radiation can harm the body's cells.

title: Recycling water in space
text: The Space Station cleans and reuses its water. Scientists studied the tiny microbes that can grow in the water system.

title: Keeping the station clean
text: Scientists regularly check the surfaces and air inside the Space Station for bacteria, to keep the crew healthy.
